in_marathi.name: Harindar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harindar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harindar is derived from Harin, meaning 'God' and dhar, meaning 'beloved'. In Hindu mythology, Harin refers to Lord Krishna, who is known for his divine love towards his devotees.
